text:
Sachin: Quick ask — we have an overnight ml-batch that needs 4x A100-40GB in us-west2 for ~3h starting ~01:00 UTC. Vendor says spare racks possible but quota needs a quick sanity check. Can infra confirm available headroom or recommend a fallback?

lee: On it. I can run a quota check now. Quick command if anyone else wants to run locally: `gcloud compute resource-quotas list --project=redwood-infer-prod --region=us-west2 --filter='metric:GPUS'`

maria: one nuance — the model here has short sequences, so A100 is preferable for cost right now, but H100 could work if we enable 8-bit quantization. Would prefer A100 if spare.

ops-bot: Automated: quota-change reminders — increase requests over 100 GPUs need billing approval. Current ask (4 GPUs) does not trigger org-level approval.

lee: Ran the check — project redwood-infer-prod: A100 quota = 8, in-use = 6 -> headroom = 2. H100 quota in us-west2 = 0. So we can't allocate 4x A100 without a quota bump or freeing GPUs.

jules: Options: (A) move part of the batch to eu-west1 (we have spare A100 there), (B) request a temporary quota bump with cloud vendor (fastest if we ask now), or (C) mix A100+H100 in us-west2 after enabling quantization — will need a config tweak and perf validation.

Sachin: Cross-region's fine for the batch (data residency not an issue). If eu-west1 has spare A100, that's probably the fastest. Any perf/cost implications for running jobs across regions?

lee: eu-west1 currently shows 6 available A100s. For batch jobs latency isn't a problem. I'll prepare a tiny terraform fallback so jobs auto-fall back to eu-west1 if us-west2 capacity < requested. Snippet I'm pushing:
```hcl
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/gpu-pool-module"
  region = var.region
  sku = var.sku  # e.g. "a100-40gb"
}
```

maria: If we do a mixed pool in us-west2, set the job flag `--use-8bit=true` and add a short eval pass. Expect ~10% perf hit but ~30% cost savings vs full A100. Worth it for non-latency-sensitive batches.

lee: Created PR #4123 (infra) that adds a region-fallback policy + a smoke test for model startup on different GPUs. Tagging @Sachin @maria for review. Also opening a cloud vendor ticket for a temporary quota bump (cc'ing procurement). Will update ticket ID here when created.

Sachin: Perfect — plan: if quota bump clears before midnight we use us-west2. Otherwise fallback to eu-west1. Please keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Billing check OK — project spending cap allows a short-term spike under $5k without manual approval. Notify if projection exceeds that.

lee: vendor ticket opened: TICKET-8674, ETA 4–6h. If anything changes I'll post here.

maria: I'll add the 8-bit flag in the job runner as a guarded toggle in the PR so we can flip it quickly if needed.

Sachin: Thanks all — will monitor and approve PR once tests pass.
